title: Capture counters
description: Totals since the archive started, per source and over all. Every capture handed to the archive ends in exactly one of committed, rejected, or still in flight (buffered).

buffered.description: Captures accepted for append and not yet committed.

dropped.description: Captures lost without a commit (a full buffer that drops, a crash recovered from). A conforming archive that never drops reports 0.

oldest_buffered_ms.description: How long the oldest buffered capture has waited: the lag.
